title: Align a single label to the lower right corner of the grid area
goal: Use justify-self and align-self to adjust individual Grid items.
summary: model stand uses a grid to display instructions and status. The description remains above and the status label is just aligned to its own cell.
tasks: Align the .badge to the end along both the inline axis and the block axis of the grid.
does not change the default alignment of the grid container, and the position of the description remains the same.

example.note: place-self sets align-self and justify-self at the same time, which can only affect one item.

hint: can also write justify-self: end and align-self: end respectively.
